{{Quote|I came here seeking help for my home. A small moon, so rich in life. Now it is all threatened.|Senaru|<ref name="Disease">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Disease on a Distant World|Taris}}</ref>}}
The [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Senaru]] lived on a '''moon''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] thriving ecosystem was threatened when a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] crashed on the moon and spilled [[hrucium]]-5 onto the surface, so Senaru traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in order to study how that planet's wildlife had adapted to toxic environments in hopes of saving his world.
